review_basis: Sixth ORVYQ system-owned byte-bound semantic visual-QA round. The stricter Pexels replacements were inspected against every claim-bound use. All five remain visually misleading, so the system rejects them and switches these specialized slots to verified official NOAA or USGS direct-source footage.

decisions.reason: The contact sheet shows a stingray on a bright sandy seabed. It is not an abyssal plain, deep-ocean ROV survey, or restrained Clarion-Clipperton Zone context.
The contact sheet shows cranes and construction barges in sheltered inland water. It does not show an offshore working-vessel deck, pipe handling, or marine lifting equipment.
The contact sheet shows a stingray naturally stirring shallow sand. It cannot represent persistent deep-seabed extraction tracks, benthic survey work, or long-term industrial disturbance.
The contact sheet shows a naval or military vessel with visible weapon hardware. It is not an oceanographic research vessel, survey crew, or scientific mapping operation.
The contact sheet is a stylized creature close-up and appears synthetic or highly staged. It does not show a real deep-ocean descent, seafloor survey, or defensible abyssal ecosystem context.
